test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ACTOR' is coded as ROYCA and 'NURSE' is coded as ESWUN. How will 'JUDGE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
The position and positional value of English alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'ACTOR' is coded as ROYCA 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01b280868c986a43ff62f0349c8161b593e46400b7877d25442d8b71209b5438.png] 

For, 'NURSE' is coded as ESWUN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ddf4c67570662ef4a49a129176dd048ebcfc7e89f9f3fd9319fa1625d7fa54.png] 

Similarly, 'JUDGE',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dedf37cf62087b3fd6af4885c8f13d6ec8bcc6831b01b6f917a1710b7d2c41c9.png] 

So, **JUDGE** will be coded as **EGIUJ.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 4'.***
